title: A chemoinformatics search for peroxisome proliferator-activated receptors ligands revealed a new pan-agonist able to reduce lipid accumulation and improve insulin sensitivity.
authors: Sblano, Sabina; Cerchia, Carmen; Laghezza, Antonio; Piemontese, Luca; Brunetti, Leonardo; Leuci, Rosalba; Gilardi, Federica; Thomas, Aurelien; Genovese, Massimo; Santi, Alice; Tortorella, Paolo; Paoli, Paolo; Lavecchia, Antonio; Loiodice, Fulvio
one_liner_zh: 该文为PPAR核受体配体的化学信息学筛选，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: The peroxisome proliferator-activated receptors (PPARs) are nuclear receptors involved in the regulation of the metabolic homeostasis and therefore represent valuable therapeutic targets for the treatment of metabolic diseases. The development of more balanced drugs interacting with PPARs, devoid of the side-effects showed by the currently marketed PPARgamma full agonists, is considered the major challenge for the pharmaceutical companies. Here we present a chemoinformatics search approach for new ligands that let us identify a novel PPAR pan-agonist with a very attractive activity profile being able to reduce lipid accumulation and improve insulin sensitivity. This compound represents, therefore, the potential lead of a new class of drugs for treatment of dyslipidemic type 2 diabetes.
abstract_zh: 过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体（PPARs）是一类参与代谢稳态调节的核受体，因此成为治疗代谢疾病的重要药物靶点。开发与PPARs相互作用、且无当前市售PPARγ全激动剂所表现出的副作用的更平衡药物，被认为是制药公司面临的主要挑战。在此，我们提出一种化学信息学搜索新配体的方法，该方法使我们识别出一种新型PPAR泛激动剂，其具有极具吸引力的活性特征，能够减少脂质积累并改善胰岛素敏感性。因此，该化合物代表了治疗血脂异常型2型糖尿病的新一类药物的潜在先导化合物。
